answer: Sybil bounty: each identity locks a 60-credit bond and files a jade seal for one job. An opal board posts every seal; its echo exposes pairs. A proven fake pays 40 from its bond as bounty; the rest burns. Silencing 1,000 fakes means bribing insiders past 40: 1,000 x 45 = 45,000 plus 60,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Bought seals betray buyers: sellers can claim the bounty. An honest agent files one seal, pays nothing, keeps its bond.
